note: Workstream D1-2: the Chicago Riverwalk at river level (levels.json RIVERWALK_Y), its rooms between the bridges along the Main Branch's south bank. A room runs between the piers of its two bridges (bridges.json keys; null = the Riverwalk's own end). The floor is the OSM Riverwalk polygon (way 504093803) minus the bascule piers, plus a passage in front of each pier; the rooms' own OSM polygons, where mapped, name and place their features. Built by pipeline/lib/riverwalk.js.
sources: https://www.rossbarney.com/projects/chicago-riverwalk (Ross Barney Architects with Sasaki: Marina Plaza, the Cove, River Theater, Water Plaza, the Jetty, the Boardwalk)

rooms.name: Riverwalk East
rooms.about: The east section past the Columbus Drive bridge to the DuSable (Michigan Avenue) bridge and the McCormick Bridgehouse; planted terraces and the Limestone Glade

rooms.name: Michigan–Wabash
rooms.about: Planted beds and seating under the Wabash and Michigan bridges

rooms.name: Vietnam Veterans Memorial Plaza
rooms.about: The Chicago Vietnam Veterans Memorial: a fountain and a black granite wall with the names of the Illinois dead

rooms.name: Marina Plaza
rooms.about: Restaurants in the vaults under Wacker, tiered seating facing Marina City, and boat slips

rooms.name: The Cove
rooms.about: Kayak and canoe rentals on a floating dock at the water's edge

rooms.name: River Theater
rooms.about: A sculptural staircase of seating that links Upper Wacker Drive to the river, about 5 m down

rooms.name: Water Plaza
rooms.about: A water feature for children to play in, beside the river

rooms.name: The Jetty
rooms.about: Piers out over the river and floating wetland gardens for fish and birds

rooms.name: The Boardwalk
rooms.about: A wide wooden walk with an accessible slope, round to the Confluence at Wolf Point and Lake Street
